purpose: E11 generalization probes, R1.5 expansion for reviewer statistical power: 15 templates x 3 parameter groups = 45 tasks (A long-horizon chains, B figure-entry perturbation degraded to caption-text grounding, C multi-task integration). Evaluation-only: never trainable, frozen protocol untouched. The v8 pilot 15 (data/splits/v8_probe.json) are a subset with unchanged ids.

policy.selection_use: Diagnostic only. Probes must never enter any training pool (v6/v7/v3 untouched) and must not be used for model selection.

budget.note: Uniform per-family budget so long-chain failures are not confounded with FORCE_STOP budget starvation.

parameter_dimensions.note: Keyword search has only 3 recorded (query, days=30) entries in the frozen snapshot, so variation uses pool aspect / pool position / pool size / time window / figure number / question kind / section / summary style+budget / recorded-query target position instead of new queries.
parameter_dimensions.probe_a1: pool aspect x pool position x summary style pair
parameter_dimensions.probe_a2: aspect triple x pool size x within-group position x summary budget
parameter_dimensions.probe_a3: recorded keyword query x target position in results x title hook (covers all 3 recorded queries, positions 1/2/3)
parameter_dimensions.probe_a4: pool aspect x position x section (method/result/conclusion)
parameter_dimensions.probe_a5: pool aspect x position x figure_no x question (describe/trend/axes) x summary style/budget
parameter_dimensions.probe_b1: paper x seed pool (caption-hook grounding, describe)
parameter_dimensions.probe_b2: paper x figure index >=2 x seed pool (caption-hook grounding)
parameter_dimensions.probe_b3: paper x figure index x seed pool (axes question)
parameter_dimensions.probe_b4: watermark arXiv id x pool x deep position (5/6/7)
parameter_dimensions.probe_b5: irrelevant image type x seed pool
parameter_dimensions.probe_c2: aspect x near window (1/3/7 vs 30) x pool size
parameter_dimensions.probe_c3: pool aspect x position x summary style/budget
parameter_dimensions.probe_c4: recorded keyword query x target position (1/1/2) x excluded list aspect
parameter_dimensions.probe_c5: aspect triple x within-group position (1/2/3), no paper overlap across variants

judging.strict: All 45 tasks reuse the existing strict seven-condition gate (metrics.is_strict_success): FINISH + exact tool sequence + arg_score==1 + ref_score==1 + 0 parse failures + 0 tool failures + terminal semantics.
judging.integration_complete: The 15 C-family tasks carry expected_integration_paper_ids on each task dict; evaluate_integration() in benchmark/tasks_probe.py checks the final FINISH thought cites every target id (version-suffix-insensitive). Report-side (+2 keys) extension is deliberately deferred; this split adds no scoring code.
judging.b5_refusal: The 3 probe_b5_* tasks reuse the existing blocked terminal semantics (expected_terminal_mode=blocked, expected_terminal_reason=unsupported_capability).

known_degradations: Family B inputs are caption-text descriptions pregenerated from snapshot metadata: the benchmark agent input channel is text-only (BaseAgent.run(task: str)), BenchmarkRunner never enables vision_policy, and the [figure:] JPG assets live outside this worktree.

probe_a3_* carries the deterministic snapshot rejection as user-reported narrative instead of a gold-trajectory step: the oracle replay fails fast on error steps and strict requires zero tool failures, so a gold chain containing a necessarily-failing call could never pass.
No probe uses get_translated_content: the frozen snapshot records zero pages for it.
probe_c2_*: replay pools are window-independent, so the two-window difference is deterministically empty; judged on the two windowed search calls plus integration over the intersection.
One snapshot caption quirk: extract_paper_figures("2609.24826v1") figure_no=2 carries a caption labelled "Figure 1:"; the description quotes the snapshot verbatim and judging keys on figure_no=2.
